prompt_md: Take 30, divide it by one half, then add 10. What do you get?
prompt_short: Take 30, divide it by one half, then add 10. What do you get?
hint_md: Dividing by one half is not the same as halving.
explain_intuition_md: Most people halve 30 to get 15 and land on 25. Dividing by one half asks how many halves fit in 30, which is 60, so the total is 70.
